description: Connects a LOINC laboratory test to the food its Component axis measures or is about.

common_properties.name: sources
common_properties.description: Data sources contributing this relationship; contains LOINC.

source_contributions.scope: Laboratory tests with CLASSTYPE = 1 and status ACTIVE, TRIAL, or DISCOURAGED; deprecated tests are excluded. Food relationships concern Component-axis analytes and exclude challenge agents, Diet (UMLS C0012155), and bare category generics.
source_contributions.description: Food targets use FoodOn identifiers. Coverage depends on BioPortal mappings to foods present in SPOKE, with additional curated LLM-assisted mappings for otherwise unresolved parts.
